name: Key level fade
thesis: First touch of an obvious level (prior-day high/low, overnight high/low) often bounces at least a few points.
rules: Levels: prior-day RTH high/low, overnight (18:00-09:30) high/low, only if the RTH open is on the near side. Resting limit touch_ticks inside the level (sell pdh/onh, buy pdl/onl), first touch only. Stop = spec.stop x ATR14 from fill, target = spec.target R. Entries 09:30-11:30, flat 12:00, max 2/day. Code: tools/backtest/setups/key_level_fade.py.
